source: 604 School of God’s Descent
target: 604 Schola Descensionis Dei

source: Under the glow of the crimson moon, Ludwig, clad in a two-piece pajama set and a small coat, recounted the memories and knowledge he had absorbed from the black-robed elder’s half-charred brain and internal organs.
target: Sub fulgore lunae coccineae, Ludwigus, indutus in duabus partibus constitutum pyjama et parvo pallio, narravit memorias ac scientiam quam ex cerebro senioris in veste nigro semi-ustae et internis membris absorpsisset.

source: He did so methodically, like an emotionless time-reporting machine.
target: Id methodice egit, instar machinae temporis relationis sine affectu.

source: “Only the brain belongs to him. His name is Prinpino.
target: “Solum cerebrum illius est. Nomen eius est Prinpino.

source: “Due to his advanced age and weakened body, he delved into mysticism. Unwittingly, he drew the attention of the Great Mother and acquired a wealth of secret knowledge, evolving into a Beyonder…”
target: “Ob aetatem provectam et corpus infirmum, in mysticam se immergit. Nescientemente, Magnae Matris attentionem attulit et divitias scientiae arcanae acquisivit, evolvens in Beyonder…”

source: Upon hearing this, Lumian muttered with a mix of mockery and fear, “Despite gaining the Great Mother’s attention, did he not turn pregnant?”
target: Audito hoc, Lumian murmure misceo derisionis et timoris incedebat: “Quamquam Magnae Matris attentionem adeptus est, nonne in graviditatem versa est?”

source: Are you truly a follower of the Great Mother?
target: Esne vere sectator Magnae Matris?

source: Ludwig continued, “I’m uncertain when Prinpino started losing his internal organs. I failed to absorb the pertinent knowledge and memories.
target: Ludwigus continuavit: “Nescio quando Prinpino interna organa amittere coepit. Pertinentem scientiam et memorias non accepi.

source: “Similarly, the time he became a human refinement product remains unknown.
target: Pariter, tempus quo factus est tamquam productum emendationis humanitatis ignotum manet.

source: “His philosophy is:
target: Philosophia eius est:

source: “Humanity, once the favored and proudest children of the Great Mother, fell into folly, aging, and weakness due to their detachment from her.
target: “Humanitas, olim filii praestantissimi et superbi Magnae Matris electi, in stultitiam, senectutem et infirmitatem cecidit propter separationem a ea.

source: “Only by allowing the divine son of the Great Mother to descend into the world can humanity be saved. They can enter Paramita and regain their original form.
target: “Solum sinendo divinum filium Magnae Matris in mundum descensum facere, humanitas servari potest; in Paramitam ingredi possunt et formam originariam recipere.

source: “When the time arrives, the Great Mother will return to the real world she governs.”
target: “Cum tempus adveniet, Magna Mater in verum orbem, quem regit, redibit.”

source: Using the gender-oriented pronoun “she” to refer to the Great Mother instead of “She”…
target: Utitur pronomine feminino “ea” ad designandam Magnam Matrem pro “She”…

source: This implies that, in the eyes of individuals like Prinpino, pregnancy and childbirth are still feminine matters.
target: Hoc insinuat, in oculis talium ut Prinpino, graviditas et partus adhuc res feminae esse.

source: A mother must be a “she”…
target: Mater debet esse “ea”…

source: This differs from the Nightstalkers…
target: Hoc differt a Noctivagis…

source: Lumian glanced at Ludwig and nodded approvingly.
target: Lumian Ludwigum aspexit et capite approbante annuit.

source: Ludwig calmly detailed Prinpino’s attempts and some of his abilities.
target: Ludwigus placide narrauit conatus Prinpino et nonnullas eius virtutes.

source: “The birth of the Child of God requires a specific body composed of various people’s internal organs…
target: “Nativitas Filii Dei corpus specificum requirit, ex variis internis membris hominum compositum…

source: “This isn’t the entire descent ritual. It lacks a crucial component…
target: “Hoc non est totus ritus descensus. Elementum maximi momenti caret…

source: “Prinpino possesses potent self-healing abilities. As a product of human refinement, he’s immune to the influence of many Beyonder powers.
target: “Prinpino potentissimas facultates autosanationis habet. Quia productum emendationis humanitatis est, multis viribus Beyonder immunis est.

source: “He can indirectly control humans corrupted by the Child of God or specific Pathway Beyonders who have had direct contact with special patients. The range is 100 meters, and they must be unconscious…”
target: “Homines, qui a Filio Dei corrupti sunt, vel certos Beyonder viae, qui cum patientibus specialibus directe contigerunt, indirecte regere potest. Spatium centum metrorum est, et illi incoscientes esse debent…”

source: Upon hearing this, Lumian suddenly recalled a Sequence 7 Vampire of the Apothecary pathway.
target: Audito hoc, Lumian subito memor tuli vampiri Sequenciae VII ex via Apothecarii.

source: Such Beyonders wielded formidable self-healing abilities and could craft Blood Slaves resembling their own marionettes!
target: Tales Beyonder formidabiles facultates autosanationis exercebant et servos sanguineos, qui propriis marionettis similes erant, creare poterant!

source: Lumian refrained from interrupting Ludwig, patiently awaiting further details.
target: Lumian Ludwigum non interpellavit, attente ulteriores singula expectans.

source: “He’s adept in surgery and can directly heal others. He knows a ritual enabling a human to survive for a period even without internal organs.
target: “Ille in chirurgia peritus est et alios directe sanare potest. Ritus eum novit qui homini permittit aliquod tempus vivere etiam sine internis membris.

source: “He can merge with trees and wooden articles for concealment, acquire a sturdy shell, and evade detection.
target: “Arboribus et rebus ligneis coniungi potest ad celandum, tegmen firmum adipisci, et detectioni evadere.

source: “He can stimulate the growth and reproduction of creatures, including but not limited to rats, fleas, bedbugs, fungi, and various plants. However, it drains his vitality. His vitality can be replenished through an unsuccessful Child of God descent ritual. Every nine rituals necessitate a batch of internal organs to be replaced…
target: “Crescentiam et reproductionem creaturarum stimulare potest, inter quas, sed non solum, mures, pulices, cimices, fungi, et varias plantas; sed hoc vitalitatem eius exhaurit. Vitalitas eius per ritum descensus Filii Dei ineffectuosum reparari potest. Omnibus novem ritibus, copia internorum membrorum restituenda est…

source: “He can also inflict curses upon others, summon malevolent creatures, consume his life for the casting of a few nefarious arts…”
target: “Praeterea maledictiones aliis inferre potest, creaturas maleficas evocare, vitam suam consumere ad efformandum nonnullas artes nefarias…”

source: As Ludwig concluded, Lumian realized Prinpino’s Beyonder powers were diverse. He possessed partial Vampire abilities and embodied certain traits of the Earth pathway’s Planter, Doctor, and other Sequences. Simultaneously, he wielded a limited grasp of dark arts, expending vitality for their execution.
target: Dum Ludwigus conficiebat, Lumian intellexit vires Beyonder Prinpino diversas esse. Partim facultates vampiricas possidebat et quasdam notas viae Terrae—Planter, Medicus, et alias Sequencias—in se incorporavit. Simul, modicam comprehensionem artium tenebrarum gerebat, vitalitatem ad eorum exsecutionem impensans.

source: It’s akin to the amalgamation of the Apothecary, Planter, and Heretic Spellmaster pathways, yet it’s not exhaustive… Such a boon exists? The Great Mother truly reigns at the apex of these three pathways… Lumian reflected momentarily before taking Ludwig’s hand and departing the suite.
target: Id simile est coniunctioni viarum Apothecarii, Planteri, et Magistri Incantationum Haereticarum, sed non est exhaustivum… Exstatne talis donum? Magna Mater vere in apice harum trium viarum regnat… Lumian paulisper meditatus, antequam manum Ludovigi arripuit et a conclavio discessit.

source: He instructed Lugano, stationed at the door, “Summon the priest from the prayer room and inform him of all pertinent details you are aware of.”
target: Praecipuit Lugano, qui ad ostium stabat, “Vocare sacerdotem ex conclavio precationis et omnes notitias pertinentes, quas nosti, ei enuntiā.”

source: After issuing his directive, Lumian deliberated before appending, “Locate the captain first, then seek out the priest.”
target: Postquam iussum dedit, Lumian deliberavit antequam addiderit: “Primum cape capitaneum, deinde sacerdotem quaere.”

source: “Alright,” Lugano assented reflexively before inquiring, “And yourself?”
target: “Bene,” respondit Lugano reflexe, deinde interrogans: “Et tu?”

source: “Of course I’m going back to bed. Should they seek an audience with me, they may wait until tomorrow morning.” Lumian gestured dismissively, guiding Ludwig along the dimly illuminated corridor to his suite.
target: “Certe, ad lectum redeo. Si audientiam a me petant, mane crastino expectare possunt.” Lumian leviter gesticulavit, Ludovigum ducens per obscurum coridorium ad conclavium suum.

source: Am I solely accountable? Lugano mused to himself.
target: Num sola culpa mea sit?

source: He suddenly noticed he stood alone at the suite’s threshold, surrounded by scattered internal organs.
target: Subito animadvertit se solum stare ad limen conclavi, circumdatus dispersis internis membris.

source: A shiver traversed his spine, prompting him to hasten toward the captain’s quarters.
target: Horrea per spinam eius percurrerunt, eum ad cellam capitanei celeriter impellentes.

source: Ten minutes later, inside the black-robed old man’s suite.
target: Decem minuta postea, in conclavio senis veste nigro induti.

source: The priest named Montserrat and the captain, Pedro, scrutinized the situation while listening to Lugano’s detailed account.
target: Sacerdos, qui Montserrat nominatus est, et capitaneus, Pedro, rem diligenter perspexerunt dum narrationem accuratam Luganoi auscultabant.

source: Nervously, Lugano disclosed to them that he was a Beyonder, a Doctor of the Planter pathway. Enio sought him out due to his exceptional skills in treating patients.
target: Perturbatus, Lugano illis declaravit se Beyonder esse, Medicum viae Planteri. Enio eum quaesivit propter artes extraordinarias in curandis aegrotis.

source: Later, during the late night, he experienced a sleepwalking episode.
target: Postea, in media nocte, somnambulium passa est.

source: When he reached the suite, he found his internal organs almost removed.
target: Cum conclavium attigerit, invenit interna organa eius paene sublata.

source: Fortunately, he was rescued by his employer.
target: Fortunate, a conductore suo servatus est.

source: Throughout the entire narrative, Lugano only omitted Ludwig’s consumption of blood, sharing everything else he knew.
target: Per totam narrationem, Lugano solam consumptionem sanguinis Ludovigi omisit, reliqua omnia quae scivit divulgans.

source: Pedro, the captain with the handsome brown beard, quipped half-seriously,
target: Pedro, capitaneus cum barba fusca venusta, semiserio exclamat,

source: “Could it be that your employer killed a passenger in this suite and deliberately scattered his internal organs everywhere, concocting such a sinister Warlock tale to deceive us?”
target: “Num fieri potest ut conductor tuus in hoc conclavio viam fecit, hospitem necavit, et interna organa eius ubique disseminavit, talem obscuram fabulam Warlock contexens ad nos decipiendos?”

source: Uh… Lugano found himself momentarily speechless.
target: Uh… Lugano se paulisper mutum invenit.

source: Indeed, this possibility couldn’t be entirely dismissed!
target: Certe, hanc possibilitatem omnino negare non potuimus!

source: Father Montserrat, garbed in a brown clergyman’s attire, shook his head.
target: Pater Montserrat, indutus vestitu clericorum fuscorum, nutuit caput.

source: “After confirming Enio’s physical condition, we’ll determine the veracity of this story.”
target: “Postquam condicionem corporis Enii comprobavimus, veritatem huius fabulae statuemus.”

source: “I concur.” Captain Pedro stroked his beard and gazed at Lugano. “What’s your employer’s name?”
target: “Consentio.” Capitaneus Pedro barbam suam traxit et ad Lugano respexit. “Quod nomen est conductoris tui?”

source: “Louis Berry,” Lugano truthfully replied.
target: “Louis Berry,” respondit Lugano veraciter.

source: “Louis Berry…” Pedro’s eyes narrowed. “The adventurer who hunted down the Demon Warlock, Louis Berry?”
target: “Louis Berry…” oculi Pedri contracti sunt. “Nonne ille adventurer, qui Demon Warlock venatus est, Louis Berry?”

source: Montserrat’s eyes widened slightly.
target: Oculi Montserrat leviter dilatati sunt.

source: “The one collaborating with the Church in Port Santa to covertly thwart malevolent forces disrupting the sea prayer ritual, Adventurer Louis Berry?”
target: “Is, qui cum Ecclesia in Porto Santa cooperatur ad malevolas vires, quae ritum orationis maritimae perturbant, occulte superandas, Adventurer Louis Berry?”

source: Wh… My boss’ reputation is so renowned? Did the Church of Earth Mother inform all the clergy that Louis Berry is a friend and collaborator?
target: Wh… Reputatio patroni mei tam praeclara est? Num Ecclesia Matris Terrae cunctos clericos certiorem fecit quod Louis Berry amicus et cooperatus sit?

source: Yes, this ship departed from Port Santa.
target: Ita, haec navis ex Porto Santa discessit.

source: The priest on board must have been the first to be informed…
target: Sacerdos in nave primo certior factus esse debuit…

source: Lugano had considered it, but he hadn’t expected his employer’s name to be so impactful.
target: Lugano id cogitaverat, sed nomen conductoris sui tam magnum momentum habere non speravit.

source: Without hesitation, he affirmed, “It’s him, Adventurer Louis Berry.”
target: Sine dubio, confirmavit: “Is est, Adventurer Louis Berry.”

source: Just as Lugano concluded his account, the entire ship was abruptly sent airborne, landing atop a wave dozens of meters tall.
target: Mox, cum Lugano narrationem suam finivisset, tota navis subito in aera iacta est et in summitate undae, quae decem metrorum altitudine erat, posita est.

source: No dark clouds or torrential rain accompanied the phenomenon, and there were no violent winds or lightning.
target: Nullae nubes obscurae aut imber torrens fenomeno comitabantur, nec venti vehemens aut fulgura apparuerunt.

source: After vaulting between the pitch-black waves several times, the steamship gently descended onto the sea’s surface, restoring calm to its surroundings.
target: Postquam inter undas nigrissimas pluries saltavit, navis vaporaria leniter in superficiem maris descendit, tranquillitatem circumiectis restituens.

source: Captain Pedro surveyed the wrecked suite and the sliding windows, then turned to Lugano with a deep inquiry, “Is this the power of your employer? I heard stories of someone practicing sea wave magic at the bar tonight. Was that a genuine wave?”
target: Capitaneus Pedro conclavium vastatum et fenestras labentes inspectus, deinde ad Lugano versa voce interrogavit: “Estne hoc vis conductoris tui? Audivi narrationes de aliquo magiam undarum maris ad tabernam hac nocte exercendam. Fuitne illa unda vera?”

source: “Yes.” Although Lugano was uncertain about the events unfolding, he attributed the display of nature’s power to his employer.
target: “Ita.” Quamquam Lugano incertus de eventibus evenientibus erat, ostentationem naturae potentiae conductoris sui attribuit.

source: He added, “He’s extending his greeting.”
target: Addidit: “Salutem suam praebet.”

source: Captain Pedro and Father Montserrat fell into contemplative silence.
target: Capitaneus Pedro et Pater Montserrat in silentio cogitativo ceciderunt.

source: After more than ten seconds, Pedro addressed Father Montserrat, who seemed to be in his thirties, “Does the Church possess knowledge of such surgeries and rituals?”
target: Postquam plus quam decem secundis transierunt, Pedro ad Patrem Montserrat, qui in annos tricesimos videtur, accessit: “Habentne Ecclesia scientiam talium chirurgiarum et rituum?”

source: Montserrat glanced at Lugano, indicating that the conversation need not be private.
target: Montserrat ad Lugano aspexit, significans sermonem non esse privatum.

source: The priest reflected for a moment before responding in a solemn tone, “There exists a faction of misguided Mother believers who contend that the decline of the modern world and the debasement of humanity result from their estrangement from the Mother.
target: Sacerdos paulisper meditatus est antequam in tono solemni respondit: “Exstat conventus cultorum Matris errantium, qui asserunt declinationem mundi moderni et corruptelam humanitatis ex alienatione ab Matre provenire.

source: “They are determined to employ any means to usher in the so‑called Child of God into the real world and invoke the Mother’s descent through the return of the Child of God.
target: Intenti sunt uti quacumque modis, ut sic dictus Filius Dei in mundum verum inducatur et descensus Matris per reditum Filii Dei invoquantur.

source: “We refer to them as the School of God’s Descent.”
target: Illos appellamus Schola Descensionis Dei.”

source: Unconvinced, Lugano inquired, “You can summon a Child of God simply by using the internal organs of ordinary people?”
target: Lugano, dubitans, interrogavit: “Potesne Filium Dei evocare simpliciter utens internis membris vulgorum hominum?”

source: While he lacked knowledge about the specific surgery and ritual, he could deduce that internal organs were a crucial component.
target: Cum scientia de specifica chirurgia et ritu carueret, concludere potuit interna organa esse partem crucialem.

source: Montserrat contemplated the remaining human organs in the suite and responded gravely,
target: Montserrat reliqua organa humana in conclavio contemplatus est et graviter respondit:

source: “The Child of God is the Mother’s child, and humans are also Mother Goddess’s children.”
target: “Filius Dei est filius Matris, et homines quoque sunt proles Matronae.”

source: Does this imply that, fundamentally, no one is superior or inferior, and they can serve as ingredients with quantity compensating for any shortcomings?
target: Implocatne hoc, fundamentaliter, neminem esse superiorem nec inferior, et posse uti ut materias, quarum copia defectus compensat?

source: Lugano grasped the essence of the priest’s statement, realizing how many rituals involving blood sacrifices could be explained by this theory.
target: Lugano essentiam dicti sacerdotis comprehendere sensit, intellegens quot rituum sanguinis sacrificiorum hanc theoriam explicare possent.

source: Father Montserrat offered no further explanation and turned to Lugano.
target: Pater Montserrat nullam ulteriorem explanationem dedit et ad Lugano se vertit.

source: “Convey to your employer that we will take charge from here. Assure him not to worry.”
target: “Transice conductor tuo, nos hinc curaturum esse; eum certum fac ne sollicitus sit.”

source: “Very well.” Lugano sighed with relief.
target: “Optime.” Lugano leviter suspiravit ex solacio.

source: The next morning, Lumian woke up promptly and realized he no longer possessed the power of the sea, preventing him from tapping into the Governor of the Sea’s authority.
target: Postero mane, Lumian celeriter experrectus est et animadvertit se potentiam maris non amplius habere, quod eum impediat ad auctoritatem Maris Praefecti pertingendam.

source: He took a regretful sip of his light beer and commenced writing to Madam Magician, detailing the issues with the School of God’s Descent and the purported birth of the Child of God in the spirit world.
target: Levis cervisiae sorbet, paenitebat, et ad Magistrae Magicae scribere coepit, describens difficultates cum Schola Descensionis Dei et putatam nativitatem Filii Dei in mundo spirituum.

source: Swiftly, the messenger returned, carrying Madam Magician’s response:
target: Celeriter, nuntius rediit, ferens responsionem Magistrae Magicae:

source: “Encountering the School of God’s Descent—I can’t ascertain whether the issue lies with you or Lugano.
target: “Conventus cum Schola Descensionis Dei—nescio utrum quaestio ex te aut ex Lugano oritur.

source: “The so‑called Child of God has already been born in the spirit world—it’s merely propaganda, you understand? Similar to the Church of The Fool’s Holy Bible—just listen but don’t take it seriously.
target: “Sic dictus Filius Dei iam natus est in mundo spirituum—tantum est propaganda, intellegis? Simile ac Ecclesia Stultorum et sua Biblia Sacra—audite, sed non grave accipite.

source: “Nevertheless, comparable incidents are unfolding, and they are brewing and evolving. This actually ties back to you. It originated from Cordu’s empty cradle, the child Madame Pualis ‘lost.’
target: “Tamen, similes casus eveniunt, et fermentantur atque evolvuntur. Hoc revera ad te refert. Ex cunabulo Cordi vacuo ortus est, puer quem Domina Pualis amisit.

source: “Additionally, based on various sources, Madame Night didn’t perish in Fourth Epoch Trier. She encountered or acquired something that advanced the matter of the Child of God.
target: “Praeterea, ex variis fontibus, Domina Nox in Aetate Quarta Trier non decessit. Illa aliquid invenit aut adeptus est quod rem Filii Dei progressit.

source: “Besides her, the Sinners’ Voisin Sanson managed to escape Fourth Epoch Trier for unknown reasons. What he encountered remains unknown…
target: “Praeter eam, Voisin Sanson peccatorum obscuris causis ex Aetate Quarta Trier effugere potuit. Quod ille invenit ignotum manet…

source: Voisin Sanson is still alive?
target: Voisin Sanson adhuc vivit?

source: Lumian was initially taken aback by the revelation in the middle of the letter, but a smile soon crept across his face.
target: Lumian initio revelatione in medio epistolae obstupefactus est, sed mox risus per faciem eius diffusus est.

source: At that moment, a knock echoed on his bedroom door.
target: Eo momento, pulsus in ostio cubiculi eius resonavit.

source: “Who is it?” Lumian, aware that it was Lugano outside, asked casually.
target: “Quis est?” inquit Lumian, sciens foris Lugano esse, leve rogans.

source: Lugano replied fearfully through the wooden door, “I-I heard a baby crying again!”
target: Lugano timide per ianuam ligneam respondit: “E-ego iterum audivi infans plorare!”
